name: 🪙 JAVIS Spot Command Center
description: Read-only bridge for JAVIS Spot accumulation, entry planning, portfolio valuation and rebalance snapshots. Shows combined context with the Binance Futures desk without exposing any execution command.

commands.name: health
commands.desc: Check whether a canonical JAVIS Spot snapshot exists, is valid and fresh. Read-only.

commands.name: snapshot
commands.desc: Summarize the latest Spot portfolio, scanner states and analytical basket. Read-only.

commands.name: asset
commands.desc: Show one asset's allocation, scanner, entry, invalidation and rebalance context. Read-only.

commands.name: rebalance
commands.desc: Show the latest analytical buy/trim baskets and projected cash floor. Does not trade.

commands.name: combined
commands.desc: Show Spot analysis beside the existing Binance Futures desk snapshot. Context only; no cross-lane execution.

commands.name: open
commands.desc: Return the configured local full-app URL for JAVIS Spot Command Center.
